attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Georgia state income tax (2025). Simplified top-marginal-rate implementation per OCGA § 48-7-20: tax = max(AGI - filing-status std ded, 0) x 5.39%. Standard deductions: $12,000 Single/MFS, $24,000 MFJ/QSS, $18,000 HOH. Real brackets are a follow-up. Writes result.computed_state_tax and result.computed_state_taxable_income.

initial_action.initial_action_dsl: set result.computed_state_tax = 0; set result.computed_state_taxable_income = 0; add " Georgia Tax Calculation (flat 5.19%, 2025)" to job.audit_trail; set result.ga_military_retirement_exemption = 0.0; perform GA_Retirement_Income_Exclusion; add " GA Schedule 1 line 7 retirement/military exclusion: $" + result.ga_military_retirement_exemption to job.audit_trail
initial_action.initial_action_postfix: 0 cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef 0 cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef " Georgia Tax Calculation (flat 5.19%, 2025)" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 cvd /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef /GA_Retirement_Income_Exclusion performtable " GA Schedule 1 line 7 retirement/military exclusion: $" result.ga_military_retirement_exemption strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"
condition_details.condition_postfix: job.filing_status "MFJ" streq { pop job.filing_status "QSS" streq } over not if

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.ga_military_retirement_exemption - 24000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * ga_tax_rate
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.ga_military_retirement_exemption f- 24000.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income ga_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.ga_military_retirement_exemption - 18000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * ga_tax_rate
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.ga_military_retirement_exemption f- 18000.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income ga_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

action_details.action_dsl: set result.computed_state_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.state_calc_agi - result.ga_military_retirement_exemption - 12000.0) and 0.0; set result.computed_state_tax = result.computed_state_taxable_income * ga_tax_rate
action_details.action_postfix: result.state_calc_agi result.ga_military_retirement_exemption f- 12000.0 f- 0.0 fmax cvd /result.computed_state_taxable_income xdef result.computed_state_taxable_income ga_tax_rate fmul cvd /result.computed_state_tax xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: GA MFJ: 5.19% x max(AGI - $24,000, 0) per OCGA § 48-7-20 Georgia AGI is federal AGI less the Schedule 1 line 7 exclusion of military retired pay (GA_Retirement_Income_Exclusion).

condition_details.condition_comment: The taxpayer has military retired pay (a taxable pension on Schedule 1 worksheet line 12)
Under 62 at year end: the military retirement income exclusion, Schedule 1 line 7b
More than $17,500 of Georgia earned income: an additional $17,500

action_details.action_comment: Schedule 1 line 7b: $17,500 plus an additional $17,500 when earned income exceeds $17,500 (O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5.1))
action_details.action_dsl: add the minimum of taxpayer.military_retirement_pay and (ga_military_exemption_under_62_base * 2.0) to result.ga_military_retirement_exemption
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.military_retirement_pay ga_military_exemption_under_62_base 2.0 fmul fmin cvd result.ga_military_retirement_exemption f+ /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef

action_details.action_comment: Schedule 1 line 7b: up to $17,500 of military retirement income
action_details.action_dsl: add the minimum of taxpayer.military_retirement_pay and ga_military_exemption_under_62_base to result.ga_military_retirement_exemption
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.military_retirement_pay ga_military_exemption_under_62_base fmin cvd result.ga_military_retirement_exemption f+ /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef

action_details.action_comment: Schedule 1 line 7a worksheet: earned income up to $5,000 (lines 3-5) plus taxable pensions (line 12), capped at $65,000 (line 16)
action_details.action_dsl: add the minimum of ((the minimum of taxpayer.w2_wages and ga_retirement_exclusion_earned_income_cap) + taxpayer.military_retirement_pay) and ga_military_exemption_65_plus to result.ga_military_retirement_exemption
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.w2_wages ga_retirement_exclusion_earned_income_cap fmin taxpayer.military_retirement_pay f+ ga_military_exemption_65_plus fmin cvd result.ga_military_retirement_exemption f+ /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef

action_details.action_comment: Schedule 1 line 7a worksheet: earned income up to $5,000 plus taxable pensions, capped at $35,000 at age 62-64
action_details.action_dsl: add the minimum of ((the minimum of taxpayer.w2_wages and ga_retirement_exclusion_earned_income_cap) + taxpayer.military_retirement_pay) and ga_military_exemption_62_to_64 to result.ga_military_retirement_exemption
action_details.action_postfix: taxpayer.w2_wages ga_retirement_exclusion_earned_income_cap fmin taxpayer.military_retirement_pay f+ ga_military_exemption_62_to_64 fmin cvd result.ga_military_retirement_exemption f+ /result.ga_military_retirement_exemption xdef

policy_statement.policy_description: Under 62 with Georgia earned income over $17,500: military retirement income exclusion of up to $35,000 (Form 500 Schedule 1 line 7b; O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5.1); 2025 IT-511 p. 20-21).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Under 62 with Georgia earned income over $17,500: military retirement income exclusion of up to $35,000 (Form 500 Schedule 1 line 7b; O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5.1); 2025 IT-511 p. 20-21)."

policy_statement.policy_description: Under 62: military retirement income exclusion of up to $17,500 (Schedule 1 line 7b).
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "Under 62: military retirement income exclusion of up to $17,500 (Schedule 1 line 7b)."

policy_statement.policy_description: 65 or older: the retirement income exclusion (Schedule 1 line 7a; O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5)), up to $65,000 of the military pension plus up to $5,000 of earned income. Other unearned income that also counts (interest, dividends, other pensions) is not modelled.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "65 or older: the retirement income exclusion (Schedule 1 line 7a; O.C.G.A. 48-7-27(a)(5)), up to $65,000 of the military pension plus up to $5,000 of earned income. Other unearned income that also counts (interest, dividends, other pensions) is not modelled."

policy_statement.policy_description: 62 to 64: the retirement income exclusion, up to $35,000 of the military pension plus up to $5,000 of earned income (Schedule 1 line 7a). Line 7b is for taxpayers under 62 only.
policy_statement.policy_statement_postfix: "62 to 64: the retirement income exclusion, up to $35,000 of the military pension plus up to $5,000 of earned income (Schedule 1 line 7a). Line 7b is for taxpayers under 62 only."

policy_statement.policy_description: No military retired pay for this taxpayer; the retirement income exclusion for other income is not modelled (#1200).
